入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 1次元、g=9.81、長さ25m、8<x<12でz=.2−.05(x−10)²m。水位.5/.1mの静水は200セル、流量4.42m²/s・下流深さ2mの定常流は100/200/400セル、t=2s。地形は区分定数セル平均。定常流から開始し、静水からの定常化実験とは区別します。 編集上の補足 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。 最終改訂は31単体検査と群全体8計算109判定に合格しました。定常流の最細N400では水深L1約.0249108、相対水深L1約.000505933です。静止湖の表現した床の釣合い、有限時間の移動定常流の誤差、乾燥床の前縁誤差を別々に保存します。 採用した計算法 非負な静水圧再構成、共有HLL流束と左右の圧力補正で地形源項を離散化します。前進Euler、面Courant数.4。静水は反射壁。亜臨界流は上流で流量・下流で水深のみを指定し他変数を外挿します。floor・clip・retryはありません。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。 SWASHES topographic flow: lakes and nonzero steady discharge Check two lake equilibria separately from nonzero subcritical flow, distinguishing lake preservation from moving-flow discretization error. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient. Editorial clarification Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope. The final revision passed31 unit checks and all109 gates over8 group runs. The finest moving steady case,N400, has depthL1 about.0249108 and relative depthL1 about.000505933. Represented-bed lake balance, finite-time moving steady errors and dry-bed front errors are retained separately. Adopted numerical method Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair. ∂th+∂xq=0,∂tq+∂x(q2/h+gh2/2)=−gh∂xz∂t​h+∂x​q=0,∂t​q+∂x​(q2/h+gh2/2)=−gh∂x​z z∗=max⁡(zL,zR),hK∗=max⁡(0,hK+zK−z∗),qK∗=hK∗uKz∗=max(zL​,zR​),hK∗​=max(0,hK​+zK​−z∗),qK∗​=hK∗​uK​ FK=FHLL(UL∗,UR∗)+(0,12g(hK2−(hK∗)2))TFK​=FHLL​(UL∗​,UR∗​)+(0,21​g(hK2​−(hK∗​)2))T q=4.42,h+z+q2/(2gh2)=2+4.422/(8g),h>(q2/g)1/3q=4.42,h+z+q2/(2gh2)=2+4.422/(8g),h>(q2/g)1/3 References and measured quantities Freeze31 unit checks and eight group runs.
